{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Antara Satrap''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that once visited the lost [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Endelaan]]. As such, navigational information concerning the planet's location was located in its logs. The ''Antara Satrap'' was boarded by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] criminal [[Renarra]], who wanted information on the location of Endelaan. Eventually, the ship was stolen, leading the ship ''[[Spiral Dancer]]'' on a chase through the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="OR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
